about: Paintings of HolyHolyHoly 3D, generated locally by tools/art.py (DreamShaper XL Lightning). Order = painting order. Prompts stay under CLIP's 77 tokens (art.py warns otherwise). Christ is painted only in icon or story compositions; the cruciform halo is His alone. Enemies are thoughts and lies, never people.
